d:
Hey guys, this is my third English translation, hope ya'll enjoy it.
This doujin is a bit on the static side, with quite a few repetitive panels, but it's still a pretty good read.
If you'd like to support my work, I'd really appreciate it, you can find my page here:
https://subscribestar.adult/lancelost

Also, feel free to let me know if there's a particular doujin you'd like me to translate or if you have any suggestions for improvement.
I'm open to requests and always looking for ways to get better.

Thanks for reading and supporting my work!
n: [Doujinshi] [Airandou] I hired a maid, and it turned out she was incredibly sensitive [English] [LanceLost]
